in_timeline.title: Opening Ceremony and Theme Introduction
in_timeline.description: Kick off the hackathon with an enhanced opening ceremony featuring keynote speakers, multimedia presentations, and premium event setup to introduce the banking innovation theme, event goals, and schedule.

in_timeline.title: Banking Innovation Challenges
in_timeline.description: Present participants with advanced creative challenges including digital payment solutions, AI-based fraud detection, customer experience improvements, and blockchain applications with expert panels and prize incentives.

in_timeline.title: Mentorship and Workshops
in_timeline.description: Offer extended expert-led workshops and mentorship sessions featuring fintech trends, regulatory compliance, advanced technical skills, and hands-on labs, supported by industry leaders and premium learning materials.

in_timeline.title: Networking and Team Building Activities
in_timeline.description: Facilitate networking sessions with professional facilitators, interactive icebreakers, and team-building exercises designed to foster collaboration and idea sharing, including social mixers with refreshments.

in_timeline.title: Project Development and Check-ins
in_timeline.description: Provide dedicated workspaces, extended development time, and regular expert check-ins for feedback and guidance to support high-quality project creation.

in_timeline.title: Final Presentations and Judging
in_timeline.description: Organize a professional presentation session with high-quality AV equipment, a panel of expert judges, and audience engagement to evaluate projects on innovation, feasibility, and impact.

in_timeline.title: Award Ceremony and Closing Remarks
in_timeline.description: Host an elegant award ceremony with high-value prizes, trophies, and closing remarks celebrating the event's success and outlining next steps for participants.

in_timeline.title: Premium Catering and Refreshments
in_timeline.description: Provide premium catering including gourmet snacks, specialty coffee, full meals, and refreshments to keep participants energized and satisfied throughout the event.
